.btn {
  display: flex;
  align-items: center;
  justify-content: center;
  border-radius: 10px;
  border: none;
  background-color: transparent;
  position: relative;
}

.btn:hover > .icon {
  transform: scale(1.2);
  cursor: pointer;
  transition: .2s linear;
}

.btn:focus > .icon {
  fill: #fd1853;
  animation: grosseur .2s linear;
}

@keyframes grosseur {
  0% {
    width: 50px;
    height: 50px;
    fill: #fd1853;
  }

  100% {
    width: 30px;
    height: 30px;
    fill: #fd1853;
  }
}
</style>
